coverage: كسرة in the same word: #1 #4 #7; كسرة on the word before: #2 #5; a كسرة added to join: #3 #6.
notes: Round 1: لِّلَّهِ (82:19) → وَلِلَّهِ (3:109); بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ (27:30) → بِنَصْرِ ٱللَّهِ (30:5), so the بسملة is not repeated after istiadha; «نحيفة» dropped. بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ (1:1) is the istiadha example (the بسملة), so the anchor is لِلَّهِ (1:2), the other light ل in الفاتحة. Notice is a near-minimal pair in consecutive ayat of البروج: بِٱللَّهِ (85:8, light) / وَٱللَّهُ (85:9, heavy): one prefix letter, كسرة vs فتحة. جزء عمّ has only five light names; #3–#6 come from elsewhere.

noticeText.en: Listen to the ل of the name in لِلَّهِ, دِينِ ٱللَّهِ and قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ: after a كسرة, even one added to join the words, it is light and thin.
noticeText.ar: استمع إلى لام لفظ الجلالة في لِلَّهِ ودِينِ ٱللَّهِ وقُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ: بعد الكسرة، ولو كانت عارضة للوصل، تُرقَّق.

examples.note: The كسرة is in the word itself (لِ): the ل of the name is light.
examples.noteAr: الكسرة في الكلمة نفسها (لِ): فلام لفظ الجلالة مرققة.
examples.why: From الفاتحة, known to every learner; the first case غاية المريد gives ({لله}).
examples.source: غاية المريد (عطية قابل نصر) https://shamela.ws/book/7311/209 ({لله}، {بسم الله}، {قل اللهم}); هداية القاري (المرصفي) 1/119–120 (paging per the OpenITI copy of shamela.ws/book/22869)

examples.note: After the كسرة of دِينِ: light.
examples.why: The word-before case, from جزء عمّ; the next ayah after نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ (heavy, lam-jh notice).
examples.source: هداية القاري (المرصفي) 1/119–120 (paging per the OpenITI copy of shamela.ws/book/22869)

examples.note: The كسرة on قُلِ is added to join the words; the ل is still light.
examples.noteAr: الكسرة في قُلِ عارضة للوصل، ومع ذلك تبقى اللام مرققة.
examples.why: The added-كسرة case named on the card and in غاية المريد ({قل اللهم}). Not in جزء عمّ. Flagged sakinayn is that added كسرة itself (the point here); the مّ (ghunnah, lesson 12) comes after the ل.
examples.source: غاية المريد (عطية قابل نصر) https://shamela.ws/book/7311/209; الميزان (فريال زمزمي) https://shamela.ws/book/38104/92

examples.note: After the كسرة of the لِ in وَلِلَّهِ: light.
examples.noteAr: بعد كسرة اللام في وَلِلَّهِ: مرققة.
examples.why: Same-word case, a new word: starts the ayah, joined to مَا; the pause sign is after word 7, outside the span. No later rule. Replaces لِّلَّهِ (82:19), whose first لّ exists only by the merged تنوين before it.

examples.note: After the كسرة of بِنَصْرِ: light.
examples.why: Word-before case. Starts the ayah, joined; the pause sign ۚ is after word 2, at the end of the span. The same word as lam-jh's نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ (heavy) with a كسرة instead of a ضمة. Replaces بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ (27:30), which repeated the بسملة of istiadha.
examples.source: هداية القاري (المرصفي) 1/119–120 (paging per the OpenITI copy of shamela.ws/book/22869); الميزان (فريال زمزمي) https://shamela.ws/book/38104/92

examples.note: بَلْ takes a كسرة to join: بَلِ. The ل of the name is light.
examples.noteAr: تُكسر لام بَلْ للوصل: بَلِ، فتُرقَّق لام لفظ الجلالة.
examples.why: A second added-كسرة word (بَلِ), at the start of an ayah, so it is said exactly as joined. Flagged sakinayn is that added كسرة, the point of the example.

examples.note: After the كسرة of بِ: light.
examples.why: Paired with وَٱللَّهُ in the next ayah.
examples.source: هداية القاري (المرصفي) 1/119–120 (paging per the OpenITI copy of shamela.ws/book/22869)

contrast.note: After the فتحة of وَ: heavy.
contrast.why: Same shape (one prefix letter + ٱللَّه), only the vowel differs. After the pause sign ۚ the reciter may start here: still heavy (فتحة).
